meta.source: MoSPI, NSS 77 All India Debt and Investment Survey
meta.revisionPolicy: Published survey estimates may be revised by MoSPI; changed source bodies are archived before rebaking.
meta.coverage: Average value of assets and amount of cash loan per household by social group: all observed sector, social group, state, sub indicator
meta.note: Interviewed in 2019. Stock reference: 30 June 2018; expenditure/borrowing flow reference: July 2018–June 2019. Means use all households unless the measure explicitly conditions on reporting. Source zeros are retained; dashes are null. No Cartesian expansion. State and small-group estimates need sample-size and RSE caution. Valuables are separate from the report’s physical and financial asset total. API indicator headings can conflict with cell units; sub-indicator units control.
meta.vintageNote: The archived AIDIS API rows contain no publisher revision timestamp. The survey report was released on 2021-09-10, but the current API body has not been established as that exact publication version.
